title: Spiritual Uprising: When God Shakes a Nation

sense.text:
“Righteousness exalteth a nation”. We weren't always in this condition. There was a time we were the most righteous people on earth, and there was also a time we were the most wicked. Now a lot of us are waking up to who we are. “but sin is a reproach to any people.” The Most High took us down because of sin, not because we were righteous and somebody attacked us for no reason. He sent the Assyrians against the northern kingdom because they were evil as hell. He sent the Babylonians against us because we were evil as hell. If we were righteous, we would never have been taken down. No nation can survive in sin. We're talking about Israel, the twelve tribes.

Moses delivered us from Egypt; we were in the wilderness forty years. Then came David and Solomon. After Solomon, the kingdom split, and the whole twelve tribes have never been together again. Christ's purpose is to bring the southern and northern kingdoms back together. Deuteronomy 28 was a prophecy given in the wilderness before David and Solomon, not something that all happened in their time. The Bible isn't written in order. Those curses happened later. We didn't believe it, but it happened.

precepts.why:
“The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib”. Those are dumb animals, but even the dumbest animals know their owners. “but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.” Our people don't know their owner or consider that they're the Israelites, that their forefathers are Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

“Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity”. That's us, laden with sin. “a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters”. A lot of us think we're righteous; God calls us a seed of evildoers. “they have forsaken the Lord”. We've forsaken God's laws and turned our backs on the Most High. You can see it today. Christians talk as if they aren't in sin, but they're worshiping idols. You're not in the truth. Repent and come out of those evil churches or the Most High will bring judgment and you will die. I'm not sugarcoating nothing.

“they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger”. Deuteronomy 28 shows that anger. The Most High took us down as a great nation. Esau and social media make slavery seem like a small thing. Those who control the narrative control the mind. What they put in front of you shapes what you think. Donald Trump is erasing black history little by little, taking things down, saying it was the past and today's white people didn't do it. He's doing it so cunningly some of you don't catch it. That's the devil for you. No Christian pastor talks about what he's doing. They're all in it together, all getting paid. He's erasing it right in front of our eyes. “they are gone away backward.” We turned away, and the Most High took us down.

sense.text: “if thou do at all forget the Lord thy God, and walk after other gods”. After the kingdom split, the northern kingdom put up idols and worshiped other gods. The southern kingdom did exactly the same thing; that's why God sent the Babylonians to destroy us. “and serve them, and worship them”. We're still doing it today. Christianity is doing it right now. “I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.” Moses warned that when we go after other gods, we're going to perish.

“As the nations which the Lord destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish”. The same way we watched the Most High destroy those nations, he would destroy us when we turned our backs on his laws. Did it happen? You damn right that happened. He destroyed the nations for sin, and we did the same things they did. We're still doing them and wondering why we're in this condition.

“because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the Lord your God.” We black people are the most rebellious people on the planet when it comes to God's laws. We don't want to hear it. A sister asks whether the Most High will really kill her just because she's wearing pants, showing her behind or cleavage. In her mind nothing's wrong with it. Those who control the narrative control the mind. Society tells you nothing will happen. You can be a hoe the whole week, dress modestly on Sunday, and a pastor makes you feel good. Sleep with hundreds of men; social media says nothing's wrong. A sister says she wants your baby but doesn't want to marry you.

I came here at fourteen. Back in Haiti, a girl in my neighborhood got pregnant before marriage. Her father made the young man marry her, found money for a visa, and shipped her to the United States anyway because she'd brought shame on the family. I knew young men who died because the girls' fathers killed them. Get a daughter pregnant, refuse to marry her when the father comes to your family, and they kill you. That's the society I grew up in. In our household with five brothers, my mother said she wasn't losing any sons: you sleep with her, you will marry her. If you don't want her, don't sleep with her. I'm not losing you over foolishness.

Look at society today: where the hell did these people come from? Twenty years ago I wouldn't have believed America would look like this. It portrays itself as a Christian, righteous nation. There's nothing righteous about America. It's the most evil country on the planet. This is where Satan's city is.

“if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes”. We fell because we wouldn't obey. “that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee”. Christians who say we're not the Israelites would have to remove Deuteronomy 28 from the Bible, and we've got way more than that chapter.

“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships”. Egypt means captivity. Cargo slave ships. “by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again”. You aren't going to see your homeland again. “and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies”. When you get to those places, you'll be sold to enemies, not friends. “for bondmen and bondwomen”. Slave men and slave women.

Slavery wasn't just picking cotton, and it wasn't some small thing. The punishments included locking people in sealed smokehouses for the smallest offenses, burning tobacco stems until the smoke attacked their lungs and eyes; putting people inside hogshead barrels with nails pointing inward and rolling them down steep hills; and holding people down while boiling pork fat was dripped on their skin. I know this is AI. It doesn't matter if it's AI or not. Did this happen? Yes. They're wiping history out of museums so they can downplay their ancestors' evil.

In 1619, twenty enslaved Africans were brought to Virginia, followed by more than 240 years of legalized trafficking before the Civil War. Enslaved people built America as architects, blacksmiths, seamstresses, and inventors. The wealth of Wall Street and the Ivy Leagues was built on their backs. Esau didn't pick the dumbest of us. He picked the best. Think about Black Wall Street, our own hospitals and schools. Where did those doctors come from? It wasn't only Black Wall Street; there were successful black towns all over America, including Georgia. They built so quickly because those men and women weren't stupid.

Women were forced into breeding farms; their pregnancies expanded property. Children were sold like livestock and babies taken from mothers before they could speak. Christianity was weaponized, with scriptures picked to make obedience seem holy. There was no happy slave; people ran, sabotaged, and fought back. Banks insured slave ships and universities took slave money. After 1865 came black codes, sharecropping, convict leasing, and today's mass incarceration. Slavery didn't end; it evolved. Slave owners received millions in compensation for lost property. The formerly enslaved got no land, education, or restitution, just freedom with nothing to stand on. That's the foundation of this country, not ancient history. Sometimes you've got to refresh the negro mind.

precepts.why:
“And I will set my face against you”. God set his face against us. “and ye shall be slain before your enemies”. We're going to be killed before our enemies. “they that hate you shall reign over you”. Those who hate you are going to rule you. Who rules us today? Esau. Christians on social media talk as if Donald Trump and the white man are supposed to love us.

Judah is whom thy brethren shall praise. The so-called freedom we have here came through African-Americans like Martin Luther King, Malcolm X, the Black Panthers, Fred Hampton, and Huey P. Newton. Those men sacrificed themselves. Haitians, Benjamin, and the northern kingdom come here and run their mouths against Judah, but Judah sacrificed so you could come here. Now people from Sudan say they're not black, they're Arab. Levi and Benjamin have been doing this for years too. Judah is the gateway that opened the door. You say Judah accomplished nothing in hundreds of years while you've got so much in fifty years? Judah died for this. How many of you died for this? What the hell are you talking about? The so-called African-American died so you can run your big mouth.

The white man doesn't say his hatred is only for African-Americans and not Haitians. He comes after everybody. Say you're Haitian, Sudanese, or Arab; he doesn't give a damn. You're an idiot if you think he puts you in a different box. He puts all of us in one box. The house of David is the whole twelve tribes. David ruled forty years, then Solomon. After Solomon we weren't together again. The Most High is bringing everybody together under Christ.

sense.text: “there arose another generation after them, which knew not the Lord, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.” That's what happens when you don't teach your children. “And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim”. They started serving Baalim, and they're still serving Baalim today in the Christian churches.

“And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers”. Our fathers never knew religions from Ellen White, Joseph Smith, John Smith, or Charles Russell. They never knew Jehovah's Witness, Pentecostal, Mormon, Baptist, or Catholicism. We never knew that garbage. “and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them”. We started following the other nations' gods. Today it's Buddha, Seventh-day Adventist, Catholicism, and the religions all around us. You'd think something had changed in 2025. Nothing's changed.

“and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the Lord to anger.” Every time you go into those churches, you bow to those devils, the men who created those religions. In the Pentecostal church you're bowing to Charles Parham; Jehovah's Witness, to Charles Russell. You're thinking you're worshiping God. God isn't inside those churches. Nowhere in the Bible does he tell you to be Pentecostal, Jehovah's Witness, Seventh-day Adventist, Mormon, Baptist, or Catholic. “And they forsook the Lord, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.” We're still doing the same thing today.

“And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel”. That's what you see today. He delivered us to spoilers and sold us to enemies until we couldn't stand before them. “Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the Lord was against them for evil”. No matter where we go, the curse follows. You were born here; I was born in Haiti. It doesn't matter where we are. The curse is on us because of disobedience to God's laws.

“In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.” Everybody doing whatever the hell they want. That's Christianity today. You're under grace, not under the law; don't worry, God won't do anything to you. Turn the sisters into hoes and single mothers and God will forgive you. That's not in the Bible.

“the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the Lord their God”. They built high places in all their cities. “from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.” Those high places today are your churches. Every Sunday you go to them thinking you're worshiping God. No, you went to worship the devil.

“And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree”. They burned incense like the heathen and provoked the Lord to anger. “For they served idols, whereof the Lord had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.” It's the same today when we go to those churches: we're worshiping idols.
“And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire”. That's abortion today.

“Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight”. God removed the northern kingdom first because they were evil as hell, worshiping idols. “there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.” Even today, go into northern-kingdom restaurants and business establishments and there are idols everywhere. I'm not saying it's only the northern kingdom.

“Also Judah kept not the commandments of the Lord their God”. Judah fell into sin too. “but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.” The same sin. “And the Lord rejected all the seed of Israel”. He rejected both kingdoms, northern and southern. Don't say the northern kingdom was evil but the southern wasn't. God got rid of all of us because of sin. He afflicted us and delivered us to spoilers until he cast us out of his sight.
“So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.” Assyria took the northern kingdom down. God sent the Assyrians against them.

precepts.why:
“Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem”. He did evil in God's sight. “Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon”. God used Nebuchadnezzar the Babylonian to take down the southern kingdom. “and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.” Both kingdoms went down because all of us were evil. The northern kingdom had idols; so did the southern kingdom. That's still what you see in black churches today.

The chief priests and people transgressed after the heathen's abominations and polluted the Lord's house. “And the Lord God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers”. God sent prophets to warn the southern kingdom because he had compassion on his people. “But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words”. They mocked the prophets. It's the same when we're in the streets today. In front of 2819 church, they mocked us: the Israelites are always yelling and screaming. There's no difference. We're the most rebellious people.

sense.text: “Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.” We fell because of sin and rebellion. We're the ones who have to change this and stop it. We've only started; there's a lot of work to do.

precepts.why:
“Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness”. The Most High took the children of Israel down because of sin and rebellion. “I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.” We didn't want to keep the law.

“Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities”. God destroyed us because of sin. “therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee”. You don't want his laws? Okay, I've got something for you. I'm going to give you to whatever you want. “and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.” That's how we fell as a nation.

sense.text:
“O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.” Bad leadership is another reason we fall. The so-called black leaders cause us to sin. Sisters are now making videos about the Christian church keeping them single and not teaching marriage. We've got videos of Pam saying marriage is bad. You cannot build a nation without marriage and families. Nation-building starts with families. You're a leader telling people marriage is bad? What the hell are you talking about?

Those pastors know their money comes from single mothers, black women giving their rent money, not black men giving thousands. One pastor embarrassed a single mother who gave $1,100 because he'd asked for $1,500. That's some evil stuff. None of these so-called black pastors or leaders talked about it. Our leaders cause us to err.

precepts.why:
“For the leaders of this people cause them to err”. Black people look at Nicki Minaj, a rapper, as a leader and spokesperson. Our daughters follow her telling them it's okay to be a hoe. We want marriage counsel from Steve Harvey when he's in his third marriage. Bad leadership. “and they that are led of them are destroyed.” Look at us: destroyed as a people because we follow everything except what God said. We follow what makes us feel good.

The Bible isn't a feel-good book. If you're looking to feel good, you're in the wrong place. It's the book that tells a black man and woman how evil they are and how to get their minds right. Christians don't believe it: you're not under the law, you're under grace; wear pants, God won't do anything. Everybody does whatever the hell they want, just like Judges 21:25. Turn sisters into hoes and single mothers and say God will forgive you. That's not in the Bible.

Why are black people mad at the Israelites for telling young men to marry their women instead of making baby mamas, take care of their children, work, and provide? We teach Christ is black and died for you. People say color doesn't matter, but it's in the Bible; what else in the Bible doesn't matter? You'll hold something against your own family for years while forgiving everybody else. The 2819 pastor explains the tattoo as a verse rather than a logo, but the tattoo goes against the Bible. Like somebody and still call out what's wrong. Once you know better, stop doing it. Why isn't he preaching that?

sense.text:
“These that have turned the world upside down”. What we're teaching is turning the world upside down, not just America. Pay attention to social media. This teaching is changing people's lives. Some of you have no idea what you've entered or what you're teaching. We have a lot of enemies. Thinking you can teach this without enemies is impossible.

This is spiritual uprising against corrupt spiritual power. For you crazy negroes thinking about picking up guns: the change doesn't start with guns and knives. It starts with the mindset. We weren't sent to fight with weapons; we were sent to change our people's minds. Go into a black neighborhood and give everyone a million dollars without changing the mind, and it's a waste. The negro will rob the brother next to him so he can have two million. Leaders keep talking finance as if that can change the community. We had Black Wall Street and many black communities, yet look at us today. The mindset didn't change.

In the fifties, sixties, seventies, leaders rose up all over: the Black Panthers, Fred Hampton, Stokely Carmichael, Patrice Lumumba in the Congo, Steve Biko in South Africa, Marcus Garvey, the brother from Haiti, Assata Shakur who just passed away, Harriet Tubman, the northern-kingdom brother from Cuba, Zapata of the northern kingdom, Fidel Castro, Malcolm X, Martin Luther King, and the brother with the red cap in Burkina Faso they're trying to kill. Steve Biko started the South African revolution, not Mandela; he was killed early, so people don't know him and only talk about Mandela. These men sacrificed themselves and their families. Most of them were killed.

I used to say they failed. I'm not saying that now. The Most High raised them for a purpose at that time, and they fulfilled it. They didn't know they were Israelites, but that little freedom we have, even being able to go into the streets and teach, came through their sacrifices. They got the job done and were killed. Now God has sent us to fulfill his purpose. Our people are rising because of what we're teaching. That's the spiritual uprising.

“Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation”. The whole twelve tribes were under David and then Solomon. After Solomon we divided against ourselves and fell. “and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand”. Don't look at America and think Republicans and Democrats are different, or Catholicism, Pentecostalism, and Seventh-day Adventism are different. They're all the same. America isn't divided like that. Yes, America will fall, but not yet.

It's the same snake. Donald Trump says something and another white man calls him racist; you think that means he's against Trump? No. Every single white person is racist one way or the other. Every single one. Some of you live in a bubble.

precepts.why:
“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”. Edom says he'll return and build. “They shall build, but I will throw down”. That's what God said, not my words. Genesis says the same thing. “The border of wickedness”. Wickedness. “The people against whom the Lord”. God says the people, the people, the people. He's talking about all of them.

Some of you say not all are racist. There's the ignorant white trash and the so-called educated white racism. The educated one pretends he isn't racist. He might even marry you; black men and women are marrying them and thinking they aren't racist. There are levels of racism, levels of hatred: some in your face and some behind closed doors. It's still hatred. A coworker brings you coffee, and you think you know him. You don't know what they're saying in their household.

sense.text: “Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!” In IUIC we're not playing with unity. Unity, unity, unity. That's why we don't want to join with other camps: we want to keep the unity. You can't build a nation without it. “It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard”. Unity is big with the Most High.

precepts.why:
“That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee”. Christ is praying that we may be one with him. “that they also may be one in us”. That's unity. Come together, one mind, one spirit, one body. That's the unity we teach in IUIC.

“that they may be one, even as we are one”. Christ gives them the glory the Father gave him. “I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one”. Perfect in one. That's unity.

“A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another”. Christ gives us the commandment to love each other. That's unity. “as I have loved you”. The same way he loves you, he wants you to love one another. “By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples”. How will they know you're his disciple? “if ye have love one to another.” By loving each other.

If you don't show love to another brother, you're not Christ's disciple. You're Satan's disciple. Everybody running their mouth showing hatred is Satan's disciple, not Christ's. Loving each other is how people tell the difference.

“For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office”. We're different members. “So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.” That's unity. Many members, but one in Christ.

sense.text:
“And above all these things put on charity”. Charity means love. “which is the bond of perfectness.” Love of the brotherhood, the unity of the brotherhood, binds us together. Before you came in here, we didn't know each other. The brotherhood's love and the Bible bind us and make us perfect in Christ.

Some of us were the worst people on earth before coming into this truth. We repented, changed our lives, and became better husbands and fathers. Some never had a man teaching them to marry the sister they were with, take care of their children and household. Now men tell you, young man, don't do it that way; do it this way. You can't put a price on that. The mindset has to change.

precepts.why:
“Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.” Endeavor means by any means necessary. Do whatever it takes to keep unity. “There is one body, and one Spirit”. That one body is Christ. One spirit. “One Lord, one faith, one baptism”. One Lord, one faith, one baptism. “One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.”

“But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.” We might not serve the same purpose, but we come together perfectly bound under Christ. He's the only one who can bring the southern and northern kingdoms together. The Bible and Christ's spirit can bring a thousand black men and a thousand Hispanics together without one fight. No other book can do that.

sense.text:
“Finally, be ye all of one mind”. One mind. “having compassion one of another”. Black people cannot spare compassion. We're quick to condemn each other and not forgive each other, but quick to forgive other nations. We pull guns and put each other to death. A white boy walks into a church and shoots a bunch of people, and in less than twenty-four hours it's, I forgive him. Your brother commits a little trespass and you hold a grudge for years: I never want to talk to you or see you again.

Have compassion toward your son, husband, wife, brother, and the sister sitting next to you. That's part of repentance and changing. “love as brethren”. Not as enemies. We are brethren, twelve tribes from one father. “be pitiful”. Pitiful means compassionate. “be courteous”. Courteous means polite, well-mannered, respectful. Respect each other.

We're quick to respect our bosses and the other nations while disrespecting each other like nothing. Black men disrespect black women and black women disrespect black men. The other nations know it and play on it. We Israelites shouldn't be like that.

“For he is our peace”. Christ is our peace. “who hath made both one”. Northern kingdom and southern kingdom, both one. “and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us”. Christ broke the division that came after Solomon. He brings both kingdoms together.

“Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances”. The ordinances were animal sacrifice. “for to make in himself of twain one new man”. One new man. “so making peace”. Peace between the northern and southern kingdoms.

“And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross”. Both kingdoms reconciled to God. The purpose of Christ dying was to unite the whole twelve tribes. Look at the Israelites marching together. That's the uprising, the spiritual uprising, the mind changing. What you're looking at has never happened on the earth before. Our weapon is the Bible. That's our weapon.

“And came and preached peace to you which were afar off”. We've been divided, afar off. “and to them that were nigh.” Both brought together. “For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.” Through Christ, both kingdoms have access to the Father. If Christ hadn't done what he did on the cross, we wouldn't have that access.
“Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners”. We're no longer strangers or foreigners. “but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God”. All praises for that.

“And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone”. Jesus Christ is our cornerstone, not man. You're not here to follow men. A dumb Israelite group said John wasn't following Christ. That's the dumbest, most stupid breakdown I ever heard. They're saying if you don't follow their group you won't make the kingdom. Well, I guess I'm not going to make it, because I'm not following no evil. Got so much hatred for their own brothers. You think we're going to follow that? Get out of here with that garbage. Christ is our cornerstone. That's who we follow.

“Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence”. Our land is overthrown by strangers. “And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.” Brothers, our job is to fight for the oppressed. How do we fight? With the scriptures. That's our job.

“See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms”. God set the men, prophets, and leaders over the nations. “to root out”. Root out the evil and lies. “and to pull down”. Pull down the evil and lies. “and to destroy”. Destroy the evil and lies. “and to throw down”. Throw down the evil and lies. “to build, and to plant.” After tearing down the lies, our job is to build.

That's what we do in IUIC, in the streets and in this building. Our programs build brothers up to go into the streets and wake our people up. Before coming into the truth, I was a little boy in a man's body. The scriptures made me a man. I'd been in Christian churches all my life and never learned these things. Take care of your wife, children, and household. Get a job. You can't hold rank without a job. Take care of yourself and be a family man. That's spiritual uprising.

“Think not that I am come to send peace on earth”. Christ didn't come to set peace on earth. “I came not to send peace, but a sword.” He came to set a sword. “For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother”. You're going to make enemies, starting in your household. Family members won't understand why you stopped Thanksgiving, Christmas, smoking weed, or smoking crack. We used to have fun together; why don't you do it anymore? Some families were happier when you were selling drugs. Now it's, what's wrong with you, why are you always in this Bible?

That lifestyle would have taken you to jail or death. Your family is mad because you escaped jail and death and got your life together. Some faithful brothers and sisters leave and join that wicked family, turning their backs on the Most High.

Sisters post videos about how they escaped a cult. We don't have guns on anybody. There's a door: you can enter or exit whenever you want. Nobody forces you. Some think leaving hurts us. Some of you need to leave. Please get the hell out. I'm begging you. You're holding progress back. Get to stepping. Those same people won't call the Catholic Church a cult. All we're saying is be a husband, wife, mother, father, be a man, and we're a cult?

We ain't shedding tears. You won't see Bishop or Deacon or any of us crying over your dumb ass. We know what we're serving. When you leave, I sleep like a baby. We're not losing sleep. I remember 2018 like yesterday; you wouldn't believe how much we've grown since people left. I'm waiting for another 2018.

A tree has to be pruned. Cut off the dead leaves so the root can produce and the tree blooms, expands, and becomes more beautiful. The Most High comes and removes dead weight. Please leave. I don't give a damn why you left; I don't want an explanation. Just go. Dollar's church isn't too far from here. 2819 isn't too far from here. Go. It's dark in there. Go enjoy the darkness.

“if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God”. If we keep the law. “to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day”. All the laws, not some. “that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth”. That's the promise. Are we above all nations today? No. That tells you we broke the law. What you see now is us trying to come back.

Above all the nations is the goal, the kingdom of heaven. That's why we're here. Don't let a man, woman, or child take that away from you. What's coming is worth it. I want every nation under me. I want power. Lord willing, I won't let anyone take it. I've reached a point where I've got nothing to lose. Some of you are old men like me, maybe twenty or thirty years left. What have you got to lose? Why let a man take your crown?

precepts.why:
“To set up on high those that be low”. That's us. God will take the lowest in society and raise them high, and nobody will see it coming. “that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.” Those mourning will be exalted. Nobody can get lower than the black man. We're the most hated people on the planet.

Everything is blamed on the black man. If it's raining outside, it's his fault. Esau kills each other, and that's the black man's fault. We can't get any lower. What have we got to lose? Look at our condition. This is what sin caused.

sense.text: “I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah”. Both northern kingdom and southern kingdom. “and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.” God is going to give both kingdoms back our land.

“But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood”. God says we're a royal priesthood. “an holy nation”. A holy people, a separate people. “a peculiar people”. Peculiar means special. We're a special people.

“who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light”. Before coming into the truth, all of us were in darkness. The Christian church is darkness; we were worshiping idols.
